title: 大槌の山林火災、ホテル総支配人は「何か後方支援を」と消防隊員に浴場を開放…延べ１０００人以上が利用
extracted_text:
平成以降２番目の規模となる１６３３ヘクタールを焼いた岩手県大槌町の山林火災は２日、発生から１１日目に鎮圧が宣言され、地元住民らは胸をなで下ろした。先月下旬の火災発生後、寝る間を惜しんで献身的な消火活動に当たった消防や自衛隊に感謝する声が相次いだ。（藤沢彩乃、山岸憲伸）
同町吉里吉里の浪板海岸。町の観光名所の一つで、返す波が吸い込まれて消える「片寄せ波」の海岸として親しまれている。この日は、午後１時に鎮圧宣言を知らせる防災無線が鳴り響くと、訪れたサーファーたちはほっとした表情を浮かべた。
近くのサーフショップ「Ｋ―ＳＵＲＦ」店主の杉本浩さん（５８）は「これで一段落」と安心した様子で語った。火災発生後、店舗前の山の裏から炎と真っ黒な煙が上がるのが見え、「店が燃えてしまう」と危機感を抱いた。東日本大震災の津波でも店が流されており、「津波の次は山火事か」とがくぜんとした。
先月末から続いた降雨で延焼は止まり、店舗も無事だった。杉本さんは「雨にこれほど感謝したことはなかった」と振り返る。大型連休中の収束に杉本さんは「県内外の人たちにも安心してサーフィンを楽しんでもらえれば」と真っ青な海に視線をやった。
吉里吉里漁港に船の様子を見に来た漁業川原繁夫さん（７１）は「あれだけ見えていた煙が収まって一安心」と周囲の山を見渡した。
介護施設にいた母親は町外に避難。自宅や漁具を入れる小屋の近くにも炎が迫り、ホースで水をかけたり、中の道具を移動させたりと、気が休まらない日々を過ごした。先月２７日から見送られていたウニ漁の解禁は８日に予定されており、「みんな待ち望んでいた。後は海が荒れず漁ができれば」とうなずいた。
同町の宿泊施設「三陸花ホテルはまぎく」総支配人の立花和夫さん（６８）は「消防隊員らの尽力で被害を最小限に食い止めてくれた」と感謝する。
施設では「消火活動はできない分、何か後方支援ができないか」と、消防隊員らに無料で浴場を開放。延べ１０００人以上が利用し、「助かった」という声も多く寄せられたという。
一方、大型連休中の客足は戻っていない。先月下旬からキャンセルが相次ぎ、満室だった連休中の予約は３分の１ほどに減ったという。立花さんは「観光シーズンの出ばなをくじかれてしまい、他の時期で埋め合わせるのも難しい」と嘆いた。
達増知事は２日、「全ての関係者の方々に感謝申し上げる。国の支援をいただきながら、町としっかり連携し、森林の再生をはじめ被害状況に対応した復旧・復興の取り組みを進める」とのコメントを発表した。
（詳しくはこちら）
translated_text:
The mountain forest fire in Otsuchi Town, Iwate Prefecture, which burned 1,633 hectares—the second-largest since the Heisei era—was declared extinguished on the 2nd day, the 11th day since it started, and local residents breathed a sigh of relief. After the fire broke out late last month, voices of gratitude have been flooding in for the fire department and Self-Defense Forces who devoted themselves to firefighting efforts without sparing any time for sleep.

At Namiki Beach in Yoshikiri district of the town. One of the town's tourist attractions, this beach is beloved for its "kata-yose-nami" waves—a phenomenon where the returning waves are sucked in and disappear. That day, when the disaster prevention wireless announced the fire suppression at 1 PM, surfers who had visited the beach wore expressions of relief.

Hiroshi Sugimoto (58), owner of the nearby surf shop "K-SURF," said with a look of relief, "Now we can finally take a breather." After the fire broke out, he could see flames and pitch-black smoke rising from behind the mountain in front of his shop, and felt a crisis that "the shop might burn down." His shop was also carried away by the tsunami from the Great East Japan Earthquake, and he was stunned that "after the tsunami, now a mountain fire."

Thanks to the rain that continued from late last month, the fire stopped spreading, and the shop remained unharmed. Looking back, Sugimoto said, "I've never been so grateful for rain." Regarding the suppression being achieved during the consecutive holidays, he looked out at the bright blue sea and said, "I hope people from inside and outside the prefecture can enjoy surfing with peace of mind."

Fisheries worker Shigeo Kawahara (71), who came to check on the boats at Yoshikiri Fishing Port, looked around at the surrounding mountains and said, "I'm relieved that the smoke that was so visible has cleared."

His mother, who had been at an elder care facility, evacuated outside the town. Flames also came close to his small shed near his home where he stores fishing gear, and he spent tense days watering with a hose and moving the equipment inside. The sea urchin fishing that had been suspended since last month's 27th is scheduled to open on the 8th, and he nodded, saying, "Everyone was really looking forward to it. Now as long as the sea doesn't get rough and we can fish."

Tatsuro Kaway, the general manager (68) of the hotel facility "Sanriku Hanahotel Hamagiku" in the same town, expressed gratitude, saying, "Thanks to the firefighters' efforts, they managed to keep the damage to a minimum."

At the facility, since they couldn't participate in firefighting activities, they opened the bathhouse to firefighters free of charge, asking, "Can we provide some kind of rear support?" Over 1,000 people used it, and many voices said, "This was a huge help."

On the other hand, customer traffic during the consecutive holidays has not recovered. Since late last month, cancellations have been piling up, and reservations that had been fully booked for the holidays have decreased to about one-third. Kaway lamented, "We were hit right at the start of the tourism season, and it's difficult to make up for it in other periods."

On the 2nd, Governor Tatsuno issued a comment saying, "I would like to express my gratitude to all those involved. With the support of the national government, we will work closely with the town to promote recovery and reconstruction efforts corresponding to the damage, including forest regeneration."

(Fujisawa Ayano, Yamagishi Nobunobu)
title_en: Mountain forest fire in Otsuchi: Hotel general manager opens bathhouse to firefighters as rear support... over 1,000 use it
